newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 1.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* Sony Corp more than doubled its pretax profit in the first quarter, buoyed by a depreciating yen and a stronger film slate.
* "Men in Black" traveled past $200 million mark domestically on Thursday and continued to close the gap with "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" as the top grosser of 1997.

* Faye Dunaway, touring in the play "Master Class," said she will not show up for her opening in Portland, Ore, on Tuesday or continue with the remaining dates unless a settlement is made on the film rights.

* Michael Jackson's "Thriller" has reclaimed the honor of the music industry's best-selling disc by topping 25 million copies sold, according to certifications released Thursday by the Recording Industry Association of America.
* Mary Parent, the New Line Cinema NLN.A executive who oversaw the movie "Set It Off," is expected to move to Universal Pictures as a senior vice president of production, sources said Thursday.
* Phoenix Pictures has hired Hallmark Entertainment's Marc Lorber to lead the company's first foray into the TV business.
